Decoratz is a function decor specialist in Polokwane that handles weddings, corporate functions, gala dinners, launches, matric farewells and themed evenings. Its services include marquee draping and bespoke decor design, and the business says it aims to deliver top-of-the-range decorations with professional service.

The company says its aim is to help clients enjoy the preparations without stress, with support from planning through to the event itself. Its website invites visitors to get in touch about corporate, wedding and themed functions. Clients planning a wedding, a corporate event or a matric farewell in Polokwane can use the business for full decor support, including bespoke decor design and marquee draping for the venue.

DR Crane Hire is a crane hire, transport and rigging company in Polokwane, established in 2007 and now one of the biggest crane hire companies in Limpopo. Its fleet includes mobile cranes, crane trucks, rough terrain cranes, forklifts and telescopic handlers, along with truck hire, machine moving and heavy transport services.

The company says it has built its reputation on reliable service, well-maintained equipment and dependable lifting, transport and rigging solutions for projects across Limpopo and Gauteng. It serves construction and industrial clients with everything from heavy lifting and construction lifts to complex site moves, and its experienced team handles projects of all sizes. The business is based at 72 Platinum Street in Ladanna.

La Fiato Luxury Lodge is a guesthouse in Dalmada, a few kilometres from Polokwane city, set in natural surroundings. Its rooms include deluxe queen and king suites as well as executive suites, with air conditioning, cable TV and tea and coffee making facilities, and the batch description notes kitchenettes and flat-screen TVs.

Pools that accommodate adults and children, a terrace, lush grounds and bomas for fireside evenings give guests space to relax. The lodge also offers free resident parking, free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception and room service, and it has wedding and conference facilities. Dalmada is about 13.7 km from Polokwane International Airport and 11.2 km from the city centre, which suits families and visitors who want a calm stay close to the city.

LEDA Lebowakgomo is a branch of the Limpopo Economic Development Agency, a wholly owned entity of the Limpopo Provincial Government that acts as the province's policy implementation arm for integrated economic development. The agency works to accelerate economic growth, industrial diversification and job creation by developing infrastructure and facilitating trade.

From its offices at Enterprise Development House on Main Road in Lebowakgomo, the branch provides enterprise development, industrial investment and business support services to the Capricorn District. It suits entrepreneurs and small businesses in the district that need practical support, and enquiries can be sent through the agency's official website.

LZ Makwela Accountants is a professional accounting firm in Polokwane Central that provides accounting, tax, bookkeeping, consulting and business regulatory compliance services. The firm assists small and medium-sized businesses across Limpopo, and it also helps construction companies with CIDB registration.

The firm says it takes time to understand each client's goals and builds customised financial solutions around them, with its Polokwane team delivering expert precision. Its website lists compliance, financial services and CIDB registration as its core areas. Business owners who need a local accountant for tax, compliance or contractor registration can find the firm at 6 Hans van Rensburg Street.

Malik Hair Stylist is a hair salon on Munnik Avenue in Sterpark, offering blow dries, braiding, weaves, colouring, balayage, keratin treatments and permanent straightening for adults and children. The salon's website describes a focus on trendy haircuts, stylish hairstyles and vibrant colour makeovers, with each look personalised to the client.

The stylist says every appointment is built around the client's own preferences and the occasion, with the aim of leaving clients feeling pampered and confident. The salon suits anyone who wants a dedicated hair stylist in Sterpark for a cut, a colour change or a special-occasion style. Bookings can be made through the website, and the salon is at 1 Munnik Avenue.

items.description:
Millennium Combined School is a public, no-fee combined school in Madiba Park, Seshego, operating as a Section 21 institution with schooling from the primary phase through to the secondary phase. The school is classified as Quintile 3, a category for a community with moderate socio-economic status, so students pay no tuition fees.

Families usually apply for a place between April and October of the year before, and Grade R and Grade 1 have specific age criteria. Parents or guardians need to bring birth certificates and immunisation cards, and non-South African citizens must provide extra documents. Provincial Learner Admissions Coordinators can help families through the process, which makes the school a practical option for children in Seshego who need a no-fee combined school close to home.

Mmilo Guesthouse is a guesthouse in Penina Park, about 3 km from the central business district of Polokwane, the capital of Limpopo. It has six en-suite bedrooms, each with a coffee station, a TV with DStv, Wi-Fi and a fridge, and some rooms have laptop safes. The rooms include twin single beds, double beds and a queen.

The name Mmilo is a Northern Sotho word for a tasty brown wild fruit found around Polokwane, and the guesthouse's motto is natural, warm and homely service. Guests can also enjoy braai facilities, free Wi-Fi and a full breakfast, which suits travellers who want a relaxed, homely base in the city.

Modern Practitioners Health and Beauty Clinic in Flora Park offers general medicine, aesthetic medicine and dental care, with a focus on preventative health. Its services include IV infusion therapy, facial and body treatments, lymphatic drainage, DMK treatments and minor surgeries, and the website also lists pricing and membership options.

The clinic's founder is a medical practitioner whose training spans paediatrics, internal medicine, surgery, psychiatry and women's health, combined with an advanced diploma in aesthetic medicine. The clinic says it aims to bring medical science and aesthetics together in one space. Patients who want general health care and aesthetic treatments under one roof can book online through the website, and the clinic is at 464 Suid Street in Flora Park.

Nirvana Learning Academy is a primary school in Nirvana, Polokwane, following the South African National Curriculum (CAPS). Its pre-school classes provide early childhood education for Grade 00, and the school says it has qualified and motivated staff who make learning a fun-filled adventure. Its motto is Learn, Lead and Achieve, and the school has around twelve teachers serving about 184 learners.

A sister school caters for children who need remedial education, and the school works closely with an occupational therapist, a speech and hearing therapist, a physiotherapist and an educational therapist. Parents can follow school events and fundraising projects on the news page, and learners are guided by a code of conduct. The school is at 41 Tagore Street in Nirvana.

Orel Christian School's Dalmada campus is a Christian school offering affordable, quality education from pre-school through Grade 7. It follows an enhanced CAPS curriculum that brings technology and information technology into the classroom, with a focus on critical thinking and collaborative learning.

The school runs an aftercare system that helps learners with homework, study methods and extra work after school. Boarding accommodation is also available on site, and families can start the admissions process online by downloading and completing the application form. A 2027 prospectus is available for download on the website, which gives families the full picture before they apply.

Pentagon College is a private institution in Mankweng, situated next to Gate 3 of the University of Limpopo, with a second campus at Maake near Tzaneen. The college teaches in English and offers courses in business management, information technology, and civil, electrical and mechanical engineering.

The college says it offers an inclusive environment where individual identity and excellence are celebrated, and it draws students from a full range of socio-economic backgrounds and cultural heritages. Its staff set high expectations for students, and its yearly operational plans set targets for achievement. Prospective students can complete the online registration form for either the Turfloop or the Maake campus.

Phuti Funeral Ministry Group is a funeral parlour based in Polokwane that offers funeral plans, funeral cover and tombstone cover to help families lay their loved ones to rest. Its services include repatriation, funeral services and cremation, tombstones for unveilings, and grave removal, relocation and exhumation.

The group offers burial plans for individuals and families, with claims processed within 48 hours according to its website, and group schemes with options such as cash back, groceries and airtime. Cashless payments are also accepted, and the website has galleries and downloads for families who want to review the plans before they commit. This Mankweng branch serves the area from Stand 32, next to Paledi Mall along the R71.

Sidze Pest Management is a family-run pest control company that delivers pest solutions to institutions across South Africa. It services food retailers, where it carries out monthly HACCP general services, as well as domestic and industrial clients, including guesthouses and hotels.

Its treatments cover ants, bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, mice, mosquitoes, spiders, ticks and flies, along with fumigation, termite treatment, disinfection, bush and tree cutting and heat treatment. The company promotes integrated pest management and draws on more than thirteen years of pest control experience in fields including fumigation, general pest control and hygiene. It is based in Bendor Park, Polokwane.
